data.value: This Run Profile is disabled, so it cannot run. {0}
data.comment: Tooltip on the Disabled chip; same text as RunProfileDisabledExplanation

data.name: RunTypeLockedHelp
data.value: The run type cannot be changed. Delete and recreate the profile to use a different type.
data.comment: Helper text on the disabled Run Type field

data.name: RunProfileAllowObjectTypeChangesExplanation
data.value: By default, an object that comes back from the Connected System under a different Object Type is refused: the Activity reports it as an error, and the existing Connected System Object is kept exactly as it is. Turn this on to carry the change out: this Full Import imports the object as a new Connected System Object of its new Object Type, and retires the old one, which is then disconnected under the usual Deletion Rules. Usually set on a second Full Import Run Profile, run by hand when the change is intended.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Allow Object Type Changes help icon

data.name: RunProfileAllowObjectTypeChangesChipExplanation
data.value: This Full Import carries out Object Type changes rather than refusing them. An object that comes back under a different Object Type is imported as a new Connected System Object, and the old one is retired.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Object Type changes allowed chip

data.name: RunProfileDeltaLimitsSummary
data.value: If the Connected System reports more deletions than either limit, this Delta Import marks none as deleted.
data.comment: Explains the deletion limits on a Delta Import

data.name: RunProfileFullLimitsSummary
data.value: If a Full Import would mark more objects as deleted than either limit, it marks none.
data.comment: Explains the deletion limits on a Full Import

data.name: RunProfileDeltaLimitsCaption
data.value: The percentage is of the objects in this run's scope not already marked as deleted, before it saves anything. Creates and updates are still applied. Each Delta Import reports withheld deletions again until you raise a limit or run a Delta Import Run Profile without one.
data.comment: Caption under the deletion limits on a Delta Import

data.name: RunProfileFullLimitsCaption
data.value: The percentage is of the objects in this run's scope not already marked as deleted, when it starts. Objects the import did see are still updated. Fix the connector's scope or raise a limit, then run again.
data.comment: Caption under the deletion limits on a Full Import

data.name: RunProfileDeltaLimitTooltip
data.value: If the Connected System reports more deletions than this, the Delta Import marks none as deleted and completes with a warning.
data.comment: Tooltip on the deleted-objects chip of a Delta Import

data.name: RunProfileFullLimitTooltip
data.value: If a Full Import would mark more than this many objects as deleted, it marks none and completes with a warning.
data.comment: Tooltip on the deleted-objects chip of a Full Import
